# NDE for Temporal Systems

> Tutorials, reviews, and papers on neural differential equations for continuous-time dynamics, irregular observations, and generative modeling.

Neural differential equations model continuous-time dynamics. This site covers neural ordinary differential equations (Neural ODEs), neural controlled differential equations (Neural CDEs), and neural stochastic differential equations (Neural SDEs).

## Pages


- [NDE for Temporal Systems](https://nde-for-ts.github.io/): Tutorials, reviews, and papers on neural differential equations for continuous-time dynamics, irregular observations, and generative modeling.
- [A Practical Guide to Neural Differential Equations (KSC 2026)](https://nde-for-ts.github.io/ksc-2026/): A KSC 2026 tutorial with eight demos on neural ODEs, CDEs, SDEs, irregular observations, continuous-time generative modeling, and state-space models.
- [Neural Differential Equations for Continuous-Time Analysis (CIKM 2025)](https://nde-for-ts.github.io/cikm-2025/): CIKM 2025 tutorial on neural ODEs, CDEs, and SDEs for continuous-time analysis of irregular time series, with examples and code.
- [Neural Differential Equations for Time Series (IJCAI 2025 Review)](https://nde-for-ts.github.io/ijcai-2025/): IJCAI 2025 survey of neural ODEs, CDEs, and SDEs for time series, covering theory, numerical methods, and benchmarks.
- [Papers](https://nde-for-ts.github.io/papers/): Research papers on neural differential equations for time series analysis.
- [Contributors](https://nde-for-ts.github.io/people/): Researchers contributing to neural differential equations for time series.

## Related resources

- [Tutorial code](https://github.com/yongkyung-oh/Stable-Neural-SDEs/tree/main/tutorial): Practical examples linked from the tutorial.
- [Scientific Inference Lab](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/): Research group homepage.
- [YongKyung Oh](https://yongkyung-oh.github.io/): Maintainer's academic profile.
